text: Türkiye Wealth Fund owns 76.1% of Türkiye Sigorta through TWF Finansal Yatırımlar A.Ş., in which the fund holds 100% of the shares; the remaining 23.9% of the shares trade on Borsa Istanbul.

source.name: Türkiye Sigorta Investor Relations: Ownership Structure (undated page, read October 2026)
source.quote: Türkiye Wealth Fund owns 76.1% of the company's shares and the remaining 23.9% of the shares are traded on Borsa Istanbul.
source.note: The same page's shareholder table lists TWF Finansal Yatırımlar Anonim Şirketi at 76.1%, with the footnote 'Türkiye Wealth Fund holds 100% of the shares in TWF Finansal Yatırımlar Anonim Şirketi.'

additionalSources.name: Türkiye Wealth Fund: Our Portfolio, Financial Services (undated page, read October 2026)
additionalSources.note: The fund's own portfolio entry for Türkiye Sigorta A.Ş. (establishment 1957).

additionalSources.name: GKC Partners (with White & Case) press release: GKC Partners and White & Case advise TVF Finansal Yatırımlar on sale of strategic stake in Türkiye Sigorta
additionalSources.quote: Following completion of the transaction, TVF Finansal Yatırımlar’s direct shareholding in Türkiye Sigorta is 76.10% and the Türkiye Wealth Fund continues to be Türkiye Sigorta’s principal shareholder.
additionalSources.note: The same release says the Türkiye Wealth Fund is the strategic investment arm of the Republic of Türkiye and wholly owns TVF Finansal Yatırımlar A.Ş.
